label: Size tier
explain: Owner ruling 2026-10-18: Small Tree 3-5 · Big Tree 5-8 · Giant Tree 8-12 · Titanic Tree 12-30+ cells (visualSizeRange at full growth); Titanic trees are seen only as the solid trunk. Pick one tier per tree; the note box takes anything else (e.g. a size inside the tier). No def changes until the sitting is enacted.
